A data type for a relationship among the victim, a perpetrator (subject), and an allegation (charge).

Charge.definition: A formal allegation that a specific person has committed a specific offense.

PerpetratorEntity.definition: A set of details about a person or organization that allegedly committed the referenced allegation.

Victim.definition: A person, organization, or other entity who suffers injury, loss, or death as a result of an incident.

types.definition: A data type for the details about a current visitation agreement

ChangesMadeAffectingVisitationRightsText.definition: A set of changes made by the court that affect current visitation rights.

VisitationDuration.definition: A period of time allowed for a visitation with the format of PnYnMnDTnHnMnS, where nY is the number of years, nM is the number of months, nD is the number of days, nH is the number of hours, nM is the number of minutes, and nS is the number of seconds.

VisitationSupervisingOfficialAbstract.definition: A data concept for an official who supervised a visit.

VisitationTime.definition: A time of day that the visitation is to take place.

types.definition: A data type for Wages Class

WagesBasePayAmount.definition: An amount of an employee's initial rate of compensation, excluding extra lump sum compensation or increases in the rate of pay. An employee's base pay can be expressed as a base hourly rate of pay or as an annual salary.

WagesBasicSalaryAmount.definition: An amount of employee compensation quoted on an annual basis.

WagesDisbursingDate.definition: A date wages were disbursed to recipient.

WagesFederalTaxWithheldAmount.definition: An amount of federal tax withheld.

WagesFederalTaxableAmount.definition: An amount of wages subject to federal tax.

WagesGrossPayAmount.definition: An amount of an employee's pay of any kind before any deductions are made by the employer.

WagesPayBasicCode.definition: A code indicating the type of wages.

WagesPayGradeCode.definition: A classification of the pay grade.

WagesPayPeriodEndDate.definition: A last date wages are included in a payment.

WagesPayPlanCode.definition: A code indicating the pay plan.

WagesPayStatusCode.definition: A code indicating the status of payment of wages.

WagesPayStepText.definition: A description of the wage ranges for pay grades.

WagesPayrollOfficeNumberText.definition: A description of the office where payroll is administered.

WagesRetiredPayEntitlementEffectiveDate.definition: A date retirement entitlement pay was effective.

WagesStateTaxWithheldAmount.definition: An amount of state tax withheld.

WagesStateTaxableAmount.definition: An amount of wages subject to state tax.

WagesTotalBasePayAllDrillsAmount.definition: A total amount of all military wages from all sources.

types.definition: A data type for the significant information regarding an alien communicated to immigration or enforcement officials notifying them of potential risk or risks.

AlertClassCategoryText.definition: A kind of grouping of the alien alert.

AlertDescriptionText.definition: A description of an alien alert.

AlertEntryDate.definition: A date on which the alien alert was entered into the system.

AlertEntryText.definition: A text of additional information on PERSON ALERT.

AlertGeneratingOfficerBadgeIdentificatio.definition: A field indicating the badge identification of the DHS Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) person generating the alien alert transaction.

AlertIdentification.definition: An identification for the PERSON ALERT.

AlertMedicalIndicator.definition: True if the alert code is for a medical condition; false otherwise.

AlertWarningIndicator.definition: True if there is an alert warning associated with an alien; false otherwise.

Alien.definition: A foreign born person who is not a citizen of the United States.

types.definition: A data type for the interface between an alien and a Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) official.

AlienAsylumRequestIndicator.definition: True if the encounter is with an alien seeking asylum; false otherwise

AlienBorderCrossingIndicator.definition: True if the encounter is with an alien crossing the border; false otherwise

AlienIncidentRoleDescriptionText.definition: A description of the role of the alien in the event.

AlienIncidentSequenceID.definition: An identifier indicating the sequence number associated with an encounter involving an alien.

AlienLookoutIndicator.definition: True if the encounter is with an enrolled alien who may be an aggravated felon, may be a suspected narcotics smuggler, has an active arrest warrant, or may be a national security risk; false otherwise.

AlienMandatoryDetentionIndicator.definition: True if detention is required for the alien; false otherwise.

AlienPhotoIndicator.definition: True if a photograph of the alien existed during encounter; false otherwise.

AlienPossessSSNIndicator.definition: True if the alien had a Social Security Card in possession at the time of encounter; false otherwise.

AlienRecidivistIndicator.definition: True if the encounter is with a non-criminal alien who has a tendency to slip back into previously recorded criminal activities; false otherwise.

AlienSmuggledCostAmount.definition: A cost associated with smuggling an alien to the United States.

AlienSmuggledIndicator.definition: True if the alien has been smuggled to the United Stated; false otherwise.

AlienVoluntaryReturnIndicator.definition: True if the alien has a history of voluntarily returning to their home country prior to being deported; false otherwise.

types.definition: A data type for a non-immigrant alien arriving in the United States on a temporary basis as a participant in a program approved by the Department of State.

AdmissionIdentification.definition: An identification of an alien I-94 admission.

AlienExchangeVisitorProgram.definition: An educational or cultural program of study sponsored by an authorized institution in the United States and offered to non-immigrant aliens.

BinationalCommissionTotalFundingSupportA.definition: A number indicating the amount of funding provided to the Exchange Visitor (EV) by the Binational Commission of the Exchange Visitors home country, in order to support his/her participation in a designated EV Program.

EnrollmentApplicationSubmissionDate.definition: A date on which the Responsible Officer (RO) or Alternate Responsible Officer (ARO) submits a DS-2019 form for an Exchange Visitor to begin a new program.

EnrollmentApplicationSubmissionOfficerId.definition: An identification of the Responsible Officer (RO) or Alternate Responsible Officer (ARO) who submitted the DS-2019, expressed as a user ID.

ExchangeVisitorTerminationReason.definition: A classification for the reason associated with EXCHANGE VISITOR's program termination.

FinancialInformationText.definition: A text string denoting the Exchange Visitors financial information.

InactiveStatus.definition: A status of an Exchange Visitor.

PL94-484AmendedIndicator.definition: True if the Exchange Visitor (EV) is participating as an alien Physician (Category code of 6), which would result in the EV being flagged as subject to the two-year residence requirement; false otherwise.

ProgramBeginDate.definition: A date on which the alien student's program begins.

ProgramEndDate.definition: A date on which the Exchange Visitor is expected to complete his/her program.

ProgramEnrolled.definition: An organized set of sponsored activities or events enrolled by EXCHANGE VISITORs.

SEVISPersonDependentAssociation.definition: An association of two people; one of which is a dependent of the other in SEVIS.

SEVISStatusChangedDate.definition: A date on which the Exchange Visitors SEVIS status changed.

SponsorReceivedUSGovernmentFundIndicator.definition: True if the Program Sponsor has received funding support from one or more United States (U.S.) agencies; false otherwise.

SubjectDescriptionText.definition: A description of the remarks about the Exchange Visitor's subject field of study.

TotalAgencyFundingSupportAmount.definition: A number indicating the total funding amount provided by a US Government agency to the Exchange Visitor (EV), in order to support his/her participation within a designated EV Program.

TotalHomeGovernmentFundingSupportAmount.definition: A number indicating the funding amount provided by the Exchange Visitors (EV) home government to the Exchange Visitor, in order to support his/her participation within a designated EV Program.

TotalInternationalOrganizationFundingSup.definition: A number indicating the funding amount provided by an International Organization to the Exchange Visitor (EV), in order to support his/her participation within a designated EV Program.

TotalOtherOrganizationFundingSupportAmou.definition: A funding amount provided by other organizations to the Exchange Visitor (EV), in order to support his/her participation within a designated EV Program.

TotalPersonalFundAmount.definition: A number indicating the Exchange Visitors (EV) personal funds, if any, being used for his/her support for attending a designated EV Program.

TotalSponsorFundingSupportAmount.definition: A number indicating the funding amount provided by the Program Sponsor to the Exchange Visitor (EV), in order to support his/her participation within a designated EV Program.

TwoYearGovernmentFinancialSupportIndicat.definition: True if the Exchange Visitor (EV) is subject to a two year residence requirement due to receiving financial support from either the U.S. or EV's Government; false otherwise.

TwoYearRequirementIndicator.definition: True if the Exchange Visitor (EV) is subject to a two year residence requirement as a result of G-1, G-2, or G-3 program participation and funding receipt from current program sponsor; false otherwise.

TwoYearSkillsIndicator.definition: True if the Exchange Visitor (EV) is subject to a two year home-country physical presence requirement due to EV's position being on the short supply skill-list within EV's home country; false otherwise.

types.definition: A data type for a non-immigrant alien who visits the United States to participate in either an educational or cultural exchange program that is approved by the United States Department of State.

ExchangeVisitorAdmission.definition: A non-immigrant alien arriving in the United States on a temporary basis as a participant in a program approved by the Department of State.

ExchangeVisitorCategoryDescriptionText.definition: A description of a kind of exchange visitor.

types.definition: A data type for the information further describing the documented identification of an alien.

AlienMiscellaneousNumberIdentification.definition: An identification number that can be used to identify an alien.

AlienNumberIdentification.definition: An identification indicating a unique number assigned to an alien's file.

types.definition: A data type for the resulting list of aliens that match all or part of a search criteria for the purpose of identifying the alien.

MatchCandidateDetainedDate.definition: A date on which the candidate for match with an encountered alien was detained.

MatchCandidateLeftFingerScoreNumeric.definition: A number indicating the left fingerprint score value of an enrolled candidate for determining his/her biometric match against an encountered alien.

MatchCandidateOverallFingerScoreNumeric.definition: A number indicating the sum of the right and left fingerprint score values of an enrolled candidate in order to determine his/her biometric match against an encountered alien.

MatchCandidateOverallMatchDecisionStatus.definition: A final decision as to whether or not the candidate is truly a hit against an encountered alien.

MatchCandidateRankNumeric.definition: A number indicating the ranking score of an enrolled candidates biometric match against an encountered alien.

MatchCandidateRightFingerScoreNumeric.definition: A number indicating the right fingerprint score value of an enrolled candidate for determining his/her biometric match against an encountered alien.

MatchCandidateStatus.definition: An indication status of whether or not a candidate has met the minimum threshold for identification as a match with an encountered alien.

types.definition: A data type for an alternate number assigned to an alien for the purposes of identification.

AlienMiscellaneousIdentification.definition: An identification of another method of identifying an alien.

types.definition: A data type for the entrance of a non-immigrant alien into full-time in an approved, accredited or certified United States educational or vocational program.

AcademicProgramText.definition: A field detailing the alien students academic program.

AcademicTermLengthQuantity.definition: A number of the estimated time (duration) of an alien students academic-term.

AdmissionIdentification.definition: An identification of an alien I-94 admission.

AlienStudentDisciplinaryAction.definition: An action taken against the non-immigrant alien student as a result of the violation of the rules of the student visa or educational program.

AlienStudentEducation.definition: An alien student's educational background and plans.

AuthorizationToDropBelowFullTime.definition: An authorization for an alien student to drop below full time status

CampusEmploymentFundsAmount.definition: A number indicating the total funds estimated to be earned by the alien student through on-campus employment.

CommentText.definition: A comment, note, or remark providing additional information.

CurrentSessionEndDate.definition: A date on which an alien students current academic session ends.

DependentExpensesEstimatedAmount.definition: A number indicating the total expenses for all alien students dependents during the term.

EnglishRequirementMetIndicator.definition: True if the alien student has met the English language requirements; false otherwise.

EstimatedTotalMiscellaneousSchoolTermExp.definition: A number indicating the total miscellaneous expenses estimated for alien student for the term.

IsNewIndicator.definition: True if the alien student is new; false otherwise.

LeftCountryIndicator.definition: True if the alien student has left the country after entering; false otherwise.

NextSessionStartDate.definition: A date on which the next school session begins for the alien student.

OtherFundsAmount.definition: A number indicating the other funds available to the alien student during the term.

OtherFundsCommentText.definition: A field indicating free text required for explanation of other funds, if any, supplied to the alien student.

OtherSchoolTermExpensesText.definition: A field indicating a free text describing an explanation required if Other Expenses are listed for the alien student.

PersonalFundsAmount.definition: A number indicating the amount of personal funds available to the alien student for the term.

PresenceUnlawfulIndicator.definition: True if the District Officer finds that the alien student is in status violation, or has been denied a reinstatement; false otherwise.

PrintedI20sQuantity.definition: A number indicating the number of I-20s printed for an alien student to date.

ProgramBeginDate.definition: A date on which the alien student's program begins.

ProgramExtensionRequest.definition: A record of the alien student request for an extension to participating in the program.

ReimbursementPaidIndicator.definition: True if the alien student has reimbursed the school for the costs of education; false otherwise.

Request.definition: A formal message requesting something that is submitted to an authority.

SEVISPersonDependentAssociation.definition: An association of two people; one of which is a dependent of the other in SEVIS.

SchoolProvidedTermFundsAmount.definition: A number indicating the amount of funds supplied to the alien student by the school during the term.

SchoolProvidedTermFundsCommentText.definition: A field indicating free text explaining the funds supplied to the alien student by the school.

SchoolTermLivingExpenseTotalAmount.definition: A number indicating the alien students living expenses for the school term.

StudentEmployment.definition: A current authorized employment of an alien student.

StudentTerminationClassification.definition: A classification of the reason why an alien STUDENT is no longer enrolled.

TermTuitionFeeTotalAmount.definition: A number indicating the total amount of tuition and fees to be paid by the alien student for the school term.

TerminationAbstract.definition: A data concept for the reason an alien student is terminated.

TerminationReasonText.definition: A field indicating free text describing the reason behind why an alien student terminated their curriculum.

Transfer.definition: A transfer of an alien student from one school to another.

types.definition: A data type for the official authorization of a non-immigrant alien to lower his or her course load below that for full-time student status.

AuthorizationDropBelowFullTimeCategoryTe.definition: A kind of reason a student has dropped below full time status.

AuthorizationF1Indicator.definition: True if the authorization to drop below full time status pertains an academic student (F-1); false otherwise.

AuthorizationFullResumptionDate.definition: A date on which an alien student resumes a full time academic schedule for enrolled program.

DepartProofDescriptionText.definition: A description of the evidence of removal of an alien from the country.

DeportationCompleteIndicator.definition: True if the deportation has been completed; false otherwise

DeportationInProgressIndicator.definition: True if the deportation is in progress; false otherwise

types.definition: A data type for the official retainer of an alien by United States immigration officials.

ActualReleaseDate.definition: A date on which the alien was released from a detention facility.

BaggageReceiptNumberID.definition: An Identifier of the claim slip given to the alien to account for his personal belongings

BarracksCategoryText.definition: A kind of living quarters of the alien who is being detained in a detention facility.

BookInOfficer.definition: A Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) Employee who books in an alien.

BookOutOfficer.definition: A Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) Employee who books out an alien.

facets.definition: A 1st Class medical is required when flight operations require an Air Transport Pilot (ATP) certificate.  An ATP is required to act as the Pilot in Command (PIC) or Captain of a scheduled airliner.
A 2nd Class medical is required when flight operations require a Commercial Pilot certificate.  A Commercial certificate is required essentially to get paid to be a pilot.

A 3rd Class medical is required for all other flight operations that require an FAA Medical Certificate.  This includes Student Pilots pursuing a Recreational or Private certificate, Recreational and Private pilots, and most Flight Instructors.

A data type describing the degree of traffic access control

facets.definition: Full access control - Preference given to through traffic movements by providing interchanges with selected public roads, and by prohibiting crossing at-grade and direct driveway connections (i.e., limited access to the facility).

Partial access control - Preference given to through traffic movement. In addition to interchanges, there may be some crossings at-grade with public roads, but, direct private driveway connections have been minimized through the use of frontage roads or other local access restrictions. Control of curb cuts is not access control
No access control - No degree of access control exists (i.e., full access to the facility is permitted).
